text:
claire_cs: FYI we have a customer (LumenLedger) spinning up a multi-region pilot. They hit a hard failure when traffic goes through their corporate proxy - requests to our EU edge are dropped. Need a temporary egress route + a small rate bump for pilot windows.
roshan_se: thanks - do they need an IP allowlist or header-based proxy passthrough?
claire_cs: Their security team insists on proxy headers. They can't change network ACLs easily. They asked if we can accept the X-Forwarded-For + set of proxy headers and exempt from strict IP checks for the pilot. Also want a 2x QPS bump for 3 days (US-EU-LATAM windows).
nate_cs: renewal flag: this pilot is tied to their renewal decision next month. If pilot stalls due to connectivity, risk increases. Need quick ops turnaround.
sam_ops: tagging infra - we can add an exception route on the edge LB and map header passthrough, but security approval required for header-based allow.
leah_security: header-based allowlist is higher risk. Can we instead require TLS client certs from their proxy? If not possible, we can accept a scoped header exception for the pilot with tight expiry and audit logging.
claire_cs: they'll only allow header passthrough for now - proxy terminates TLS. They can provide a static proxy cert chain if that helps. Pilot is next Tue/Wed, so turnaround is ~72 hours.
roshan_se: can you share the proxy header sample and proxy cert CN? I'll draft the scoped exception.
claire_cs: sample header they can provide:

X-Forwarded-For: 203.0.113.45
X-Client-Cert-Serial: 12AB34CD56
X-Corp-Proxy: lumen-proxy-01.internal

roshan_se: ok. Ops steps I think: 1) add temporary header-exempt rule on EU edge (duration 72h), 2) apply QPS bump: +1000 qps for the customer account across routes during pilot windows, 3) enable enhanced access logs to S3, 4) require cert evidence from customer.
sam_ops: infra-bot - please open a short-lived exception change (SRE-EXC) for EU edge and schedule rollout at 02:00 UTC Tue.
infra-bot: Created ticket SRE-EXC-2026-8729. Change window Tue 02:00-03:30 UTC. Assigned to sam_ops and roshan_se. Please add approval from leah_security.
leah_security: I reviewed SRE-EXC-2026-8729. Approve conditional on: a) cert chain uploaded to KMS, b) log retention set to 90 days for that customer's logs, c) auto-revoke at window end.
roshan_se: noted. Claire - can you get cert chain + written approval from their sec contact? Also confirm timeframe for QPS bump windows (local business hours).
claire_cs: pinged their sec (marco@lumenledger). He confirmed he'll upload the cert bundle to our secure intake link and an email approval. QPS windows: Tue 14:00-18:00 CET, Wed 10:00-16:00 CET.
sam_ops: prepping the config snippet for change - adding here for review:

edge.rule.allow.headers = ["X-Client-Cert-Serial","X-Corp-Proxy"]
edge.rule.header-exempt-ttl = 259200  # 72h in seconds
account.lumenledger.qps.override = 1000
logging.edge.customer = "lumenledger-pilot-eu"

roshan_se: looks good. Two small requests: set a stricter header match for X-Client-Cert-Serial (regex) and add a canary rollout of 5% traffic for first 15m.
sam_ops: will add canary 5%/15m and regex. Updating ticket.
infra-bot: SRE-EXC-2026-8729 updated: added canary policy and header regex. Change window remains Tue 02:00 UTC.
claire_cs: thanks - I'll confirm cert upload and email approval. Nate - I'll loop you in on the renewal note once pilot is green.
nate_cs: perfect. If pilot shows stable latency <200ms and no errors, I'll mark renewal as low-risk. Otherwise I'll escalate.
claire_cs: closing loop - cert uploaded, approval email from Marco received. Please proceed. :thumbsup:
sam_ops: rolling change started. watching logs.
infra-bot: Canary: 5% traffic diverted at 02:05 UTC. No errors detected in first 10m.
sam_ops: promoting to full exception now. QPS override applied for Tue/Wed windows.
roshan_se: security note: logs stored in s3://redwood-sec-logs/lumenledger/pilot/ - leah, confirm retention policy applied.
leah_security: retention set to 90 days and audit logs enabled. Auto-revoke scheduled at Tue 05:00 UTC + 72h.
claire_cs: customer confirmed pilot success at end of day. Nate - renewal downgraded to green. Thanks team! :party_parrot:
